summary: Created in step 2 of esv::party_preset::System::ProcessDirtyLoadStates (bg3.exe+0x2DBEC00) while a party preset is loaded onto a character: holds the total experience the character must get for the preset's level.

fields.name: TotalXP
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2DC0F10 allocates 4 bytes and writes 0. bg3.exe+0x2DBEC00 (case 2) stores into it an int computed from the preset level (LoadState+0x1BC) through FUN_141029290(level+1, ...) (XP-for-level lookup) and capped by LoadState+0x314; 0 when there is no level data.
